topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with framing remarks connecting the session to prior histopathology practicals and outlining the day's learning objectives.

topics.label: Discovery and assaying of transforming oncogenes from tumor virology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses uncovered cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for measuring cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and functional mechanisms of cancer gene mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer-associated mutations are categorized into functional classes and how different allele alterations disrupt normal cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, pathways, and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinct forms of genomic instability arising from DNA repair failures and mitotic errors alongside their downstream cellular consequences.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the sequential accumulation and inherited presence of genetic alterations govern the trajectory of tumor development and evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture concludes with closing remarks, recommended reading, and a preview of the next topic.
